mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in real GDP growth signals a weakening economy that will produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings estimates are revised downward.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of instances where GDPC1 YoY growth is below 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the unemployment rate signals a weakening labor market and consumer spending power, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly negative in periods following a 0.5pp+ rise in UNRATE over 3 months (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: An accelerating rise in industrial production signals strengthening economic activity and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.1 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in housing starts signals a weakening housing market and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where HOUST declines > 10% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the CPI inflation rate signals rising input costs for corporations and a potential Fed tightening response, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly negative in periods following a CPI print > 4% YoY (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in real retail sales signals strengthening consumer spending and economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 30% of instances where RSAFS rises > 10% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in payroll employment signals strengthening labor market and consumer spending power, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises > 200k per month for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.1 over any 3-year rolling window when PAYEMS rises > 200k for 3+ months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary policy that will produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise for corporations and consumers.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly negative in periods following a 50bp+ rise in FEDFUNDS over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).
